title: A finite counterexample to the weighted Yamabe heat trace comparison
description:
We give a finite smooth counterexample in dimension three to Conjecture 1 in Carlo Morpurgo's contribution to Oberwolfach Report 6/2009, printed pages 421-422. On the round three-sphere the positive weighted Yamabe operator W^(-1/2)(Delta+3/4)W^(-1/2) is normalized by the conformal volume integral of W^(3/2) equal to 2 pi^2. An explicitly capped cylinder of length 10000 gives a specified weight and positive time with scaled heat trace greater than 13/20; the round maximum is less than 321/500. Both maxima are attained. This refutes the assertion over all dimensions n at least 3. The assertion restricted to n at least 4 and the adjacent monotonicity question remain unaddressed.

The qualitative negative answer is a straightforward assembled consequence of classical cylindrical conformal geometry, a chosen fixed rescaled cap, Dirichlet min-max and an elementary round trace bound. Ammann and Jammes and the earlier constructions cited there are credited; no new geometric or spectral mechanism is claimed. The note records an explicit finite quantitative application to the historical comparison and exact rational certificates. Related transformed-trace inequalities of Morpurgo are distinguished. A dated bounded priority audit found no earlier explicitly assembled exact refutation in its inspected corpus, with version and retrieval limits recorded. Historical priority of the exact application, worldwide firstness and current openness are unestablished.

The deposit contains a four-page research note and a verification archive with editable source, all 42 frozen original files and three evidence archives, fresh independent mathematical and bounded-priority reviews, exact arithmetic and integrity checks, and semantic negative controls. Downloaded primary publications are excluded; source locators and hashes are retained. OpenAI tools were used extensively in development, solving, drafting, coding and adversarial verification. This is an unrefereed preprint; no completed external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed. Arithmetic and integrity checks do not prove the analytic lemmas or certify priority.
